notes.title: Planar Disturbances Midterm Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

The Planar Disturbances Midterm is here, and with it comes eight new Legendary runes, one Limited Edition rune.  The Midterm update includes a game patch for PC, Mac, and PlayStation 4 versions of the game.

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/Expansion_29_Midterm_Banner_Large.jpg

General

The Planar Disturbances Midterm Pack has been added to the Pox Nora Marketplace. This pack will give 1 of the 8 new Legendary Planar Disturbances Midterm runes along with 2 Platinum Tokens.
The Planar Disturbances Mid-Term Bundle has been added to the marketplace will award the Limited Edition Festival Mika rune with unique art and sprite, 1 of the 8 new Legendary midterm runes, and 2 Platinum Tokens.

New Runes
Legendary

Draksar Confessor
Elder Vampyre
Icefang
Jellebrium Nexus
Rockcharger Warbeast
Sarnghavian Gladiator
Vashal Interceptor
Vothsair Overlord

Limited Edition

Festival Mika

Fixes & Changes

Addressed several server stability issues.
Addressed some visual effects that were not in the correct position.
League Rewards are now correctly rewarding Gold, Shards, and Packs.
Daily campaigns should now correctly cycle and will no longer give a incorrect notification of not being able to play.
Quests are now properly giving progression credit.
The Deck Manager will now correctly update when using the Mouse.
In-Match players will no longer need to hit the A Key twice to go into targeting mode.
Resolved a rare issue that would cause the game to stop processing game server updates in a match.
Improved detection parameters for awarding trophies.
Addressed an issue that would sometimes cause the game to not load into a Custom Game Bot match.
The Victory & Defeat screens will now correctly display if the match was Ranked, Skirmish, or Solo Play.
The Victory and Defeat screen will now show the correct league progression value.
The In-Match rune details will now correctly show the selected unit’s damage value.
When in the queue for a Ranked Match the popup will now say ‘Looking for Opponent’ instead of ‘Entering Queue’.
The rarity filter for the Rune Manager now displays the correct rarity type.
Legendary Runes can now be correctly Sacrificed or Forged.
The Rune Filter will no longer exclude runes that have multiple races or classes if only one of those races or classes is selected.
Runes will now correctly display their secondary races and classes.
The campaign cinematic dialogue box will no longer cover up the portrait for the champion who is talking.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from changing difficulty for a campaign once it has been beaten.
Fixed a bug that was causing a match to not correctly end if a Shrine or Avatar was killed by indirect damage.
The league progression will now correctly display the progress for 1v1 separately from 2v2.
Progress in the 1v1 league will no longer count towards the 2v2 league.
Fixed an issue where the abilities Iron Will, Fearless, and Unstoppable were not functioning if they were a champion’s base ability.
The Condition popup for Incorporeal has been updated to have the correct description.
The spell Execution Order no longer charges nora based on affected units.
The ability Lethal Poison will longer kill Bosses or Avatars.
The ability Chains of Amareth will no longer kill the Chained Fae if it has the upgrade ability Vitality: Nora.
The ability Rapid Growth will now correctly start on cooldown and will go on cooldown when activated.
The spell Naturalize will no longer remove terrain effects.
The spell Execution Order will no longer cost more nora based on the number of champions affected.
The relic Mystic Whirlpool will no longer cause inconsistent interactions with champions using relocation abilities.
Illusions will no longer be able to drop nora globes.
The K'Thir Forest map will now correctly display what tiles are considered to be water.
The condition Blinded can no longer be bypassed by abilities like Pounce, Censure, and Starlight.
If the ability Iron Will is removed from a champion they will now correctly become Distracted if Shimmering Flower is equipped.
The equipment Avarice now functions as intended.
The condition Crystallized can no longer have its secondary effects cleansed separately from the condition itself.
The equipment Medal of Valor will now correctly remove Speed when unit's MAX RNG goes above 2.

Changes

Abilities
Forglar Swamp
Ironfist Stronghold
K'thir Forest
Savage Tundra
Sundered Lands
Underdepths

Discussion: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/patch-notes-planar-disturbances-midterm.28281/

notes.title: Pox Nora Hotfix: June 30th, 2017
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

A new hotfix has been deployed to Pox Nora.  This hotfix is all server related, so PC, PS4, and Mac players will all get the benefits of this change.

Hotfix

The issue causing Custom Bot matches to occasionally stay on the loading screen indefinitely has now been fully isolated and will no longer occur.  This ended up being related to the system that allowed bots to use Player Decks.  For the time being bots will not use player decks until a new system can be implemented.
All players will now correctly receive League Rewards when reaching a new league.  These rewards will appear as packs in the Marketplace Rewards section of the lobby when they are awarded.
Daily and Heroic Quest will now properly give track progress and award the correct rewards upon completion for all players.
The ability Rapid Growth will now correctly start on cooldown and will go on cooldown when activated.

Note: All missed rewards from the League and Quest issues have not yet been retroactively rewarded.  We want to make absolutely sure these are 100% not happening for anyone before giving out any compensation.

Steam Summer Sale

The Steam Summer Sale is still active until the 5th of July so make sure you pick up the Pox Nora Steam Bundles before they return to their normal prices.

Discussion: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-hotfix-june-30th-2017.27650/

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Pox Nora Client Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

It is our pleasure to announce the release of the all new Pox Nora game client!  As part of this release we have a massive update to game balance.

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/PoxPSXWeb.jpg

All New Game Client

Steam: If you play through Steam, the client update will be automatic.
PC: Players who use the PC stand-alone launcher (non-Steam), please download the new launcher.
Mac: The new Mac version will be available through Steam ONLY.
PlayStation 4: Pox Nora can be downloaded for free from the PlayStation Store.

Please Note: The old game client will be no longer be supported.

New Lobby
The game lobby for Pox Nora has been completely redone to make navigating with both Mouse and Controller as snappy as possible.

Custom Games
There is a new Custom games section where players can create matches against other players or bot.

Deck and Rune Manager
You can now create, choose, and edit your decks fully within the game.

Marketplace
The Pox Nora Marketplace is now fully integrated within game client.

Player Details
You can not only see your League Progression, but now Match history, Rankings, and Feats (formerly Achievements) are now accessible within the game client by clicking on your account name in the upper right corner of the lobby.

Premade Decks 
As part of the new game client we will be phasing out the current Public Decks. These will be replaced with Premade Decks. Upon logging into the the new game client each player will be awarded the "Ironfist Inquisition" premade deck. This is a fully functioning deck that can be edited. All the rune in the deck will also be yours. To prevent exploitation, the runes from this deck can not be sacrificed in the Rune Forge or Traded. This deck will only be added to a player's account once. Otherwise all of you will be able to do anything you want with these runes, and new players will have a deck to start editing as soon as they launch the game. Additional decks can be earned by beating the Faction campaigns in the Training section of the game.

Cross-Platform Play
All players, whether through PlayStation, PC, or Mac, will all be able to play against each other regardless of platform! In addition, multiplayer for Pox Nora will not require a PlayStation Plus account.

Account Link
Existing Pox Nora players will be able to copy their PC or Mac account's inventory over to their PlayStation™Network account. Please note account cloning will only be available for 90 days at the time the game is released on the PS4, and Accounts may only be copied once. Accounts once copped will there after be treated as separate accounts and will no longer share inventory information. The Account Link feature will be accessible through the Player Details section of the PlayStation 4 version of the game.

Patch Notes
Abilities
Forglar Swamp
Forsaken Wastes
Ironfist Stronghold
K'thir Forest
Savage Tundra
Shattered Peaks
Sundered Lands
Underdepths

Disscussion: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-new-pox-nora-client-released-may-23rd.27004/

See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Companionship Gala and February 9th Patch
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

Development of the new Pox Nora game client is continuing to progress, but as that draws closer a preparatory patch is needed to make some back end changes to the game.

This patch will also include some things that all of you will notice including some balance changes.

Companionship Gala 2017
It is once again time to celebrate the bonds of platonic love between friends, companions, and comrades. This is the driving force behind the factions and races of Poxanthuru to work together and build coalitions for protecting their kin from those who would do them harm.

Once again you will be able to see one such relationship stands above all others.  The everlasting bond between Ayla the Huntress and Thor the Tempest Boar are on display in the True Love campaign.

notes.title: Pox Nora Winter 2016 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

We want 2016 to end with a Bang, with a Massive Update and Awesome Deals!

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/WinterSaleLarge2016.jpg

We are happy to say the free Winter Holiday campaign featuring the lovable Krampus is once again available. Along with the Holiday Reskin, Holiday Bundle, and Holiday Extended Set Special packs.

The Holiday Packs and free Winter Holiday campaign are available from December 15th, 2016 to January 5th, 2017.

We appreciate the patience and support of the Pox Nora community. This Massive Update for all of you to play over the winter holidays includes a ton of balance and bug fixes, but more so, it includes a lot of the back-end work we have done in preparation of the new Pox Nora game client. Things are now at the point where we can start bringing the two versions in sync with one another and do this massive update!

General

Added a new Holiday Bundle pack to the Marketplace. Each pack contains 3 Exotics and 1 Legendary from the Spirits Beyond, Visions of Amareth and Path of De'lim expansions, along with 10 Platinum Tokens and 5000 Shards
The festive Holiday Reskins pack is available again on the Marketplace. Each pack comes with 1 Limited Edition rune from 8 holiday themed reskins of legendary runes and 2 platinum tokens.
The Holiday Extended Set Special pack is now available on the Marketplace. Each of these packs give the following runes from the Extended Set: 1 legendary, 1 exotic, 2 rares, 4 uncommons and 4 commons.
For a limited time the Winter Holiday campaign featuring Krampus will be available to all players for free. Completing this campaign on Legendary difficulty will award 2 Platinum tokens.
Five new Wallpapers have been added to the PoxNora.com.

Ability Changes

High Ground has been consolidated into Hunter: Walker
Hunter: X abilities no longer stack with each other
All of the Jab abilities have been consolidated into being Sabotage abilities with the following format:

The next enemy champion deployed from the runedock while this champion is in play takes 6  damage and gains Vulnerability: .

The following abilities have been renamed:

Bloodless has been renamed Eternal
Reclaim Relic is now Ruin

Restless Souls, Voil Caverns, New Growth, Gravebind and Corpse Restoration, etc. now all trigger once per turn only
Sustain has been consolidated into Transfer Life
Swoop has been consolidated with Pounce, retaining the Pounce name but being single target

This champion is relocated to the closest non-damaging space to target enemy unit within 5 spaces and makes a Physical attack at +2 DMG against the target if able.
AP: 4, CD: 2
This means that most Swoop champions are now slightly better, benefiting from the reduced AP cost and CD

Massive Leap has renamed to Seismic Leap and redesigned to

This champion is relocated to target space within 4 spaces. Enemy champions within 2 spaces of the target takes 10 Physical damage (this damage ignores DEF), are knocked back 1 space and become Slowed for 2 turns.

Shatter Summoned is now:

Area Effect 3, Range 5: Enemy illusions and summoned units take 15 Psychic damage.
AP: 3, CD: 3
This allows for greater control over the effect area and increases the AP efficiency of the ability as well as the maximum output of the ability

A new ability "Blood Spear" has been added:

This champion makes a Loss of Life attack at RNG 2-5. If the target is Bloodied or has less than 50% HP remaining , this champion vampiric heals for 8.
Nora: 7, AP: 4, CD: 3
Bloodbinder Count and Demonvein Vampyre have this ability

A new ability "Vine Whip" has been added to the game!

Description: This champion makes a Physical attack at RNG 2-5. If the target is occupying Vegetation, Ensnared or Rooted and is successfully damaged, the target also becomes Burred for 3 turns and Eviscerated for 3 turns.
Nora: 6, AP: 4, CD: 3
Seed of Potential, Naria Ragevine, Tainted Vinecreeper and Tree Spider have this ability


Champion Changes

Due to the size, the Patch Notes have been modified to not display runes that have only had their cost change due to ability cost changes (rather than an actual change to the rune's kit/design)
Access to Dispel has been greatly reduced in Protectorate factions
A number of lower cost champions lost a drawback ability to decrease efficiency
Distribution of Commander, Defender and Boost have been adjusted. Themes should generally only have access to a single one of these
Distribution of Healing has been changed. Protectorate factions get stronger healing but at higher cost and CD generally, while Wrath factions get weaker healer but at lower cost and CD, as well as "alternate" forms of healing such as Transfer Life more frequently.

Spells, Relics and Equipment Changes

Many Spells, Relics and Equipment have had their descriptions cleaned up as part of our ongoing efforts to streamline game text and add condition/ability linking
A number of Spells and Equipment have gotten redesigns
All Warbanners now cost 25 nora
Cleansing Emerald is now ST/KF, with Impairing Sapphire being moved to SP/SL, expect Impairing Sapphire to get a redesign at some point down the line
A number of equipment now gives the actual ability equivalents of their effects, instead of a one-off version. For example, Elsari Shackles granting Careless instead of causing AP loss on its own

Conditions Changes

Intoxicated condition no longer debuff enemies. The fact that this was both a debuff and a buff at the same time caused bugs and issues from both a technical and a balance perspective. The "Mead Trap" relic has been redesigned to accommodate the change since it'd no longer work properly.
Illuminated condition no longer gets removed on attack. This means that it no longer generates nora either, but will debuff the enemy's DEF and ability to Stealth for the entire duration. This was done to simplify the condition a bit as it was doing a lot of different things at once, as well as to emphasis it's debuff/anti-stealth side instead.

Bugs (General)

Fixed an issue with the Gold bonus timer refunding upon relaunching client on some accounts.

Bugs (Abilities)

Fixed an issue where Death Harvest was not working at all
Fixed an issue where some abilities were bypassing Buffers:

Hunter: X
Cull
Psychological Warfare

Fixed an issue where Frost Stance was not granting Catalyst: Frost correctly.
Fixed an issue with the ability Bulwark Jakei that was preventing it from working.
Fixed an where if a player possess a champion with Riftwalker that champion could be sacrificed even if the player is not the owner.
Fixed an issue where the ability Hunter: Quick was triggering on units with less than 7 SPD.
Fixed an issue where the ability Impairing Luminescence wouldn't spread to other Nora Gems.
Fixed an issue with the ability Elusive Leap what was preventing non-basic attacks (such as Constriction).
Fixed an issue where Scouring and Eviscerating Luminescence wouldn't trigger abilities like Hunter.
Fixed an issue where several abilities were not affected by the SL faction bonus or Hunter abilities:

Deafening Aura
Psychic Ping
Rebuke
Flame Siphon
Fry
Wail of Grief
Melt
Shred Defense
Sonic Roar
Magic Beam
Black Tempest
Cannon Barrage
Elemental Storm: Poison
Elemental Storm: Frost

Fixed an issue where if a champion had both Warguard and Combat Awareness 2 they would take 0 damage from spells but still cause Warguard to trigger.
Fixed an issue where the ability Zeal: Speed wouldn't show a condition when triggered.
Fixed an issue where the ability Shroud would incorrectly stack.
Fixed an issue where Acolyte abilities sometimes wouldn't trigger from start of turn effects like Auras.
Fixed an issue where the ability Preparation would lose stacks if the unit has Skirmisher and fails to attack a relic.
Fixed an issue where the ability Bodyguard would redirected damage incorrectly and be prevented by Combat Awareness by changing Bodyguard to cause Loss of Life instead of damage
Fixed an issue where the ability Spell Breach worked on enemies and relics.
Fixed an issue where the ability Logistics: Force Barrier incorrectly gave Rank 2 instead of Rank 3 of Force Barrier.
Fixed an issue where the ability Reveal: Kas Pupil could be used more than once if the player had effects that could reduce the CD.
Fixed an issue with the abilities Grant: Teleport and Grant: Reflexes having an incorrect range of 7 when it should have been 5.
Fixed an issue with the ability Haunting Visions where it was triggering at 30 or less.
Fixed a couple of issue with Mirror Swap. First, it was considering older illusions as closer when they weren't and where it could swap at a longer range than intended.
Fix an interaction issue with the ability Short-Lived that was causing other abilities to not work properly.
Fixed an issue with the ability Poisonburst ignoring Blinded/Evasive.
Fixed an issue where the ability Confuse could be used against Impenetrable units.
Fixed an issue where the champion Elven Druid's Bear and Eagle Forms would the champion's range.
Fixed an issue where casting the spell Crescendo on a Shielded unit would still use nora.
Fixed an issue where the spell Inhibit Power would trigger Snow Blind when centered on a unit.
Fixed an issue where the spell Wings of Steel's effects could not be removed via Dispel
Fixed an issue with the ability Shrine Mulligan not re-reveal Preordained runes.
Fixed an issue with the abilities Shadestrike and Snowstrike that required successful damage instead of successful attack.
Fixed an issue with the ability Fairy Flight not giving back Flight if unit goes above 15 HP via +MAX HP gains.
Fixed some odd behaviors that could occur if the ability Scrapper was triggered on the opponent's turn.
Fixed an issue where Strike abilities did not work on relics.
Fixed an issue with the abilities Blood Magic and Cannon Barrage where they could be used while pacified.
Fixed an issue where the champion Dwarven Hooligan's ability Attack: Keg wasn't in the first ability slot.
Fixed an issue where some relocation effects were bypassing Wandering and Reckless Flight. In addition, when relocation abilities are used the champion will relocate to an adjacent space if the target space is occupied by a stealthed unit.
Fixed an issue where the spell Alacrity plays the effect on every single unit, causing significant delay/slowdown
Fixed an issue where the ability Arcblade: Frost's second and third attacks were doing Physical damage instead of Frost.

Bugs (Spells)

Fixed an issue where the spell Lost Trails was incorrectly requiring a friendly deployment zone to be targeted.
Fixed an issue with the spell Pilfered Armory not working.
Fixed an issue where the spell Bullseye's effect would incorrectly lasts 6 turns instead of 1.
Fixed an issue with the spell Ritual of Ashes's Cursed DMG bonus stacking on each champion.
Fixed an issue where the spell Divinity's Touch no longer worked on champions with the ability Elite.
Fixed an issue where Draconic Pulsar required a target
Fixed an issue where the spell Fan Faire did not have a range preview.

Bugs (Relics)

Fixed an issue where the relic The Resistance did not give Slam to newly deployed Elementals.
Fixed an issue where the first Zombie from Corpse Pile incorrectly had upgrades.
Fixed an issue where the relic Lava trap would not spawn stealthed.
Fixed an issue where the buff provide by Collective Struggle was incorrectly removable via Dispel.
Fixed an issue where the Blackguard Banner's effects are incorrectly removable via Dispel.

Bugs (Equipment)

Fixed an issue with the equipment Chillshard was not properly triggering when new Attacks are gained.
Fixed an issue with the equipment Everfrost Manacles' Frost damage is incorrectly prevented by the SL bonus.
Fixed an issue where Magnetized from the equipment Moga Magnet was pulling units together more than 5 spaces away.
Fixed an issue where the equipment Lightning Rod wouldn't trigger off certain abilities.
Fixed an issue with the spell Stellar Horizon where if it is cast from the runedock, then it comes off CD, and then cast it again, it will heal for more than expected amounts.
Fixed an issue where the spell Psionic Storm would increases in AE by 1 for every 2 champions instead of for every champion.
Fixed an issue with the equipment Barbed Vine Leash where it would damage champions who Teleports but not champions who Leaps.
Fixed the equipment Avarice to have the proper description. Also resolve issues related to race change effects, and if the equipment was unequipped the DMG debuff was being kept. Now works properly with Goblins.

Bugs (Conditions)

Fixed an issue where the condition Burred was not reduced by the ability Tough
Fixed an issue with the condition Illuminated not affecting DEF granted by Calcify.

Glossary

For this patch due to it's size we have opted to split it up into the respective Faction's Forums. This will also make it easier for all of you to comment about faction specific changes.

Main Patch Notes
Healing Abilities
Abilities Part 1
Abilities Part 2
Forglar Swamp
Forsaken Wastes
Ironfist Stronghold
K'thir Forest
Savage Tundra
Shattered Peaks
Sundered Lands
Underdepths

Discussion: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-winter-patch-of-2016.25401/

See you on the battlefield!

notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

Thanks to all of your feedback we have been able to make some balance tweaks and bug fixes that have popped up with the release of the Planar Disturbances expansion.

Also, If you missed the news Pox Nora will be coming to PlayStation 4 and the PlayStation Vita.  Checkout the trailer for details.

General Changes

The ability Scry has been removed from the game, most champions previously with Scry now has Gift of Scrying instead.
The Manual Reveal options has been disabled.
Xulos the Glorious now has his properly glorious flavor text.

Bugs

Statue of Xulos and Aspiring Servant now work with the new Xulos.
Fixed an issue where the ability Dragonflight, Updraft and Blessing of Al'mara were not granting Hunter: Walker.
Fixed several issues that would result in error messages in a match.
Fixed an issue with the ability Rift Nova not damaging enemies in a DMZ if the DMZ was not friendly.
Fixed an issue with the relic Burning Steel where it would not deal damage on deploy.
Fixed an issue where Hunter abilities were triggering on Shrines/Relics.
Fixed an issue where the ability Hunter: Crippled wasn't triggering.
Fixed an issue where the ability Kill Sense was not triggering if the source of the Slowed condition was not Kill Sense.
Fixed an issue where the ability Hunter: Meek was triggering on everything.

notes.title: Planar Disturbances Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

Planar Disturbances is here, and with it comes new runes that expand upon the themes of Spirits Beyond and starts establishing some new ones.  Enjoy the all new campaign and be rewarded with Commander Nisk for taking on the challenge of beating it on Legendary difficulty.  If you want an in-depth breakdown for the design decisions of this expansion then be sure to watch the Preview Video.

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/EXP29Launcher_Banner.jpg

General

49 New runes have been added to Pox Nora. Two of these new runes are Limited Edition.
The League Rewards have been updated to award Planar Disturbances runes.
The all new Madness in the Mountains campaign has been added to Pox Nora, and is available for purchase on the Marketplace. Find out what new threat has been unearthed in the mountains of Valdac. Completing this brand new campaign on Legendary difficulty will award the Commander Nisk limited edition rune!
Planar Disturbances Pack has been added to the Marketplace. This pack comes with: 6 common, 3 uncommon, and 1 rare rune. Each rare slot has a 10% chance of becoming an exotic. Each pack comes with 1 FREE Platinum Token.
Planar Disturbances Box has been added to the Marketplace. This box comes with 10 Planar Disturbances packs. Get 9 packs and the 10th is FREE. The first pack is guaranteed to contain an Exotic and 500 FREE Shards.
Xulos the Glorious Skin Bundle has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This bundle contains the Limited Edition Xulos the Glorious, a variant skin for Xulos, Undead Sage with unique art. 1 Random Exotic rune from Planar Disturbances, and 2 Platinum Tokens.
Planar Disturbances MegaBox has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This megabox comes with three boxes of Planar Disturbances, an additional 500 Shards along 5 FREE Platinum tokens.
An all new Planar Disturbances Story chapter is now available!
The Spirits Beyond expansion has been added to the Rune Forge.
The Pox Nora Terms & Conditions have been Revised.

Xulos the Glorious

Full reskin of Xulos with unique ability effects
Available via the Planar Disturbances Xulos Bundle

New Ranked Map Rotation

Axillium
Elemental Plateau
Forsaken Wastes
Forsaken Wastes II
Grove of Ashes
Ironfist Pass
K'thir Forest
Nora Glades
Ruins of Valdac
Shores of Maljara
Snarling Tangle
Underdepths

Rune Reveal Changes

Shrine Scry has been changed to be a multiple use mulligan.

Description: Obtain a new set of starting runes. This ability is removed after use, if you play a rune, or after the first round.
This has caused some changes to some existing runes/abilities, such as Sibling.

Rune Reveals now default to 8 for first player and 9 for second player.

General Mechanic Changes

Fortify has been removed from all Shrines and Avatars.

Relics, Shrines, and Avatars no longer have immunity to Poison or Disease.

All the Chuck abilities can now target relics and should only summon units with no upgrades.
All the Swarm abilities will now summon to the closest available space.  Any champion summoned this way will no longer have any upgrade abilities.

Stitched Remains will now spawn to the closest available space when a champion with Stitched is destroyed.
All the Hunter and Foe abilities and a number of other abilities have been consolidated into just being Hunter abilities.
The Sundered Lands faction bonus has changed.

Description: Champions you control take 1/2 less damage from champions.

Logistics abilities now trigger on Class in addition to race.
Continued standardization/consolidation of abilities to AE5, to similar CDs for the expected type, etc.
The ability Deception returns!

Description: This unit is relocated to target space within 5 spaces, 3 Illusion copies of this champion are randomly spawned within 5 spaces of its original location.


Banned Runes

Phoenix Anklet has been re-enabled for ranked play following a bug fix
Darkmarsh Warsong has been re-enabled for ranked play following a redesign

Nora: 25
Description: The next 3 Boghoppers you deploy from the runedock become Stealthed for 6 turns and costs 10 nora less.


Drums of War and Player Ranks
All players who played a minimum of 50 ranked matches and their primary faction was the Drums of War Winning Faction, Underdepths, have been awarded 2000 Gold along with 5 Three Day Gold Bonus Tokens.

Fixes

Fixed several issues that would result in error messages in a match.
Fixed an issue with Ruby and Sapphire Catalyst that when these relics should be destroyed they would be also healed and persist.
Fixed an issue were damaging auras were triggering triggering the ability Swarm when Swarm specifically states basic attacks.
Fixed an issue that when Relocate: Relic was used to move a Relic adjacent to an enemy champion with Aggressive, the ability Aggressive would be triggered.
Fixed an issue where the Reflection ability incorrectly reflected Attack: Loss of Life.
Fixed an issue where the ability Born in Blood would not cause bloodied.
Fixed an issue where the ability Black Tempest would affect the same champion more than once.
Fixed an issue with the equipment Phoenix Anklet's Short Lived where the champion was not properly being killed by Short-Lived, and fixed a similar issue with the spell Escape Magic.
Fixed an issue with where the ability Split would not spawn on a champion damaging terrain.
Fixed an issue where the ability Swoop could be used while a champion was Pacified.
Fixed an issue where the ability Scythe Whirl wouldn't break stealth.
Fixed an issue where the buff from Reclaim Relic would remain if it was used on an enemy relic.
Fixed an issue with the spell Waylay where it would create a real instead of a summoned champion.
Fixed an issue where the effects of Avenging Flame could not be cleansed.
Fixed an issue with the ability Corpse Restoration where a Shambling Zombie would still be summoned when the unit with the ability died.
Fixed an issue where the ability Fledgling Mimicry would incorrectly triggers off Relics.
Fixed an issue where the effects of the ability Ritual of Power were not properly ending.
Fixed an issue where the equipment Scorched Earth wouldn't correctly spawn the champion if the equipped champion was destroyed.
Fixed an issue with the relic Flash Bang would not trigger on stealthed or deployed units.
Fixed an issue where the relic Artillery Marker would sometimes bypass abilities and effects that should have prevented the target from being affected.
Fixed an issue where the condition Foul Rite could not be cleansed.
Fixed an issue where the ability Wind Aura's range preview was not appearing.
Fixed an issue where Desecrated Zone would not apply Elsari Coven's Cursed in some cases
Fixed an issue where the range preview of Call of the Hunter was displaying the old range of Relocate: Ally.
Fixed an issue where Cracked Egg was not properly creating a champion in some instances.
Fixed an issue where Flame and Frost Armor were giving an old implementation of Damage Shield.

Changes

Abilities Part 1
Abilities Part 2
Forglar Swamp
Forsaken Wastes
Ironfist Stronghold
K'thir Forest
Savage Tundra
Shattered Peaks
Sundered Lands
Underdepths

Discussion: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23672/

See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: The Spirits Beyond Midterm is Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

The Spirits Beyond Midterm is here, and with it comes eight new Legendary runes, a Rating reset, and more!

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/SBMIDTerm.jpg

General

The Spirits Beyond Midterm Pack has been added to the Pox Nora Marketplace. This pack will give 1 of the 8 new Legendary Spirits Beyond Midterm runes along with 2 Platinum Tokens.
The Spirits Beyond Midterm Bundle has been added to the marketplace, which contains 3 Spirits Beyond midterm Legendary runes along with 5 platinum tokens.
All player Ratings have been reset as part of this Midterm. League progression will remain unchanged, so players can continue their progression.
New Wallpapers have been added to PoxNora.com.

New Legendary Runes

Arroyo Riftwalker
Frostwing Slayer
Mother of Frond
Myx Incubator
Naria Strangler
Swift Current
Valdaci Shieldwarden
Zombie Rotwrapper

Mechanic Changes

Change the Knockback mechanic so if a champion with no AP, when they would be knockbacked into a chasm, they take 5 DMG per Knockback square instead.  It now functions like being knocked into an object.

Bug Fixes

Fixed various game crashes.
Fixed an issue when the ability Eternal Life triggers where it was giving the champion created the default upgrades instead of selected upgrades.
Fixed an issue where the ability Dragon Form was not properly granting the ability Flamestrike.
Fixed an issue where the ability Dispel would work on champions with Impenetrable,
Fixed an exploit that allowed untradeable champions to be traded by using the increase bid option.
Fixed an issue with the condition Locus Swarmed where it would presist if the affected champion was in the AOE when effect ended.
Fixed an issue where the equipment Akakios's Blade is not giving Flamestrike when it is equipped on Draksars.
Fixed an issue where the ability Stasis would trigger if it was given to an already deployed champion.  It should now trigger only when a champion comes into play.
Runes that were for the use in Single Player campaigns that some players were able to get through exploits can no longer be used in Ranked Play. 
Fixed an issue with the ability Still Life's stealthed condition would go into negative numbers and would not properly refresh when the champion did not move.
Fixed an issue when Damage Over Time Immunity abilities when triggered would create a new ability.
Fixed an issue where the ability Avatar was not preventing them from being targeted by the Bloodseeker ability.
Fixed an issue with the ability Preparation were it was only resetting when the attack is successful.

Changes

Abilities
Forglar Swamp
Forsaken Wastes
Ironfist Stronghold
K'thir Forest
Savage Tundra
Shattered Peaks
Sundered Lands
Underdepths


See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Pox Nora Patch Notes: April 7th, 2016
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

We have a patch for all of you to address some of the feedback and observations that have come up since the release of Spirits Beyond.

Changes

Fixed several issues that would result in error messages in a match.
Fixed an issue where the Flying description on abilities that give this effect was out of date.
Fixed a typo in the Visions of Amareth story.
The status effects for Enraged will now properly show the amount damage was increased.
Fixed an issue where the equipment Special Prize would not give the condition Defenseless after 4 attacks and would sometimes duplicate the equipment to a friendly champion.
Fixed an issue where the spell Forced Reconstruction would not deploy the Misshapen Boghopper on lava.
Fixed an issue on the website where sometimes a players name would appear twice in Search for Player.
Fixed an issue on the website where not all of the non-standard leagues were being shown on the rankings pages.
Fixed an issue where the ability Irresponsible Essence Imbibment was not causing the champion to gain HP.
Fixed an issue with the ability Mind Lock where if the target had no non-basic attack activated abilities the ability would still go on cooldown.
Fixed an issue with the ranked map rotation where the wrong versions of Tundra Lake and Lost City were being used.
The effects of the spell Warchief Inauguration can no properly be dispelled.
Fixed an issue the prevented the spell Glimpse of Death from being deployed from Rune Dock.
Fixed an issue where the ability Prismatic Sigil was giving the melee Frost Attack, Fire Attack, and Magical Attack instead of the range specific versions.
Fixed an issue where the ability Dragon Form was not giving the ability Flamestrike when the champion is transformed.
Fixed an issue with the relic Long Fuse Bomb that was causing it not to work.

Changes

Abilities
Forglar Swamp
Forsaken Wastes
Ironfist Stronghold
K'thir Forest
Savage Tundra
Shattered Peaks
Sundered Lands
Underdepths

For the full list of the changes in this patch checkout the official patch notes: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/patch-notes-april-7th-2016.22533/

See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Spirits Beyond Expansion Released!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

Spirits Beyond is here, and with it comes new runes, a campaign, balance changes, and more!  Now you can see everything that was brought up in the Preview Video as you play.

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/PoxSPBanner.jpg

General

51 New runes have been added to Pox Nora. Three of these new runes are Limited Edition.
The League Rewards have been updated to award Spirits Beyond runes.
The all new challenging Hand of Death campaign has been added to Pox Nora, and is available for purchase on the Marketplace.  Completing this brand new campaign on Legendary difficulty will award the Glimpse of Death limited edition rune!
Spirits Beyond Pack has been added to the Marketplace. This pack comes with: 6 common, 3 uncommon, and 1 rare rune. Each rare slot has a 10% chance of becoming an exotic. Each pack comes with 1 FREE Platinum Token..
Spirits Beyond has been added to the Marketplace. This box comes with 10 Spirits Beyond packs. Get 9 packs and the 10th is FREE. The first pack is guaranteed to contain an Exotic and 500 FREE Shards.
Spirits Beyond Megabox has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This mega box comes with three Spirits Beyond boxes, one of 2 LEs (Valdaci Emerald or Valdaci Shield) and an additional 5 FREE Platinum tokens.
The rewards for Heroic Achievements no longer count against the daily gold limit.
Made some more improvements on the back end to the Heroic Achievement system.
The Rune Forge limit on crafting Exotic and Legendary runes has been increased to 20 per week from 6 per week.
Now available, an all new Spirits Beyond Story Chapter.
The Visions of Amareth expansion has been added to the Rune Forge.
Due to player feedback we have given the Mountain Slag champion new art.  The old art has been repurposed into a new Armored Fesh for Spirits Beyond.
Website is now fully using the new League icons.
Website rankings will now include all non-Standard Leagues.
Range champions have been adjusted to be more balanced in relation to melee.

Maps & Map Rotation

New Map Versions

Axillium II
Forsaken Wastes II
Forsaken Wastes III
Shores of Maljara II

Updated Map Layout

K'thir Hill

New Ranked Map Rotation

Dark Marsh
Ironfist Mountains
K'thir Forest
Lava Plains
Lost City
Ruins of Valdac
Tundra Lake
K'thir Hill
Axillium II
Forsaken Wastes II
Forsaken Wastes III
Shores of Maljara II

Game Mechanic Changes

Faction Bonus for having a full faction K'thir Forest has now been changed to +1 Speed not +1 Speed and +1 AP.
The Diseased condition no longer causes Inhibited
The Scoured condition no longer causes -1 Defense
The Poisoned condition no longer causes -1 Defense and -1 Damage
Relics can now be Eviscerated

Visions of Amareth Final Days Event
The Visions of Amareth Final Days Event has concluded.  Packs have been awarded to players based on fulfilling the reward criteria of 1 Visions of Amareth pack for every 10 Ranked matches played lasting 10 minutes or longer. To redeem the packs once they have been rewarded, you will need to go to the Marketplace and click on the link that says Entitlements at the top of the screen.

The winner of Grand Prize for the Visions of Amareth Final Days Event can be found on full Patch Notes.

Drums of War and Player Ranks
All players who played a minimum of 50 ranked matches and their primary faction was the Drums of War Winning Faction, Forsaken Wastes, have been awarded 2000 Gold along with 5 Three Day Gold Bonus Tokens.

Fixed several issues that would result in error messages in a match.
Fixed an issue that was resulting in enemy champions being deployed at the Player's Shrine on the Wrath Walkthrough Campaigns.
Fixed an issue where the condition from the spell Escape Magic couldn't be dispelled.
Fixed an issue that was causing the spell Mirrorhold to instantly destroy champions with the Titan ability.
Fixed an issue where the ability Divine Regeneration was cleansing the  Sundered Lands Avatar.
Fixed an issue where the equipment Soul Reaver continually defile in AE3 while it was equipped.
Fixed an issue with the ability Blindfire where the minimum range of the ability wasn't reflecting the min range of the champion.
Fixed an issue where the ability Planar Bound would not prevent relocation from the spells Undertow and Swap.
Fixed an issue where the ability Teleport: Blood Ball would use AP and go on cooldown when targeting a Blood Ball that is on inaccessible terrain.
Fixed an issue where the condition Incorporeal was calculating Damage before Defense not after, which resulted in higher than intended damage reduction.
Fixed an issue with the spell Pride of Sarnghaver where it would not last the full duration and could not be dispelled when it should.
Fixed an issue where the ability Soulsift would not trigger if the champion is killed by the ability Short Lived.
Fixed an issue where the ability Feint was using the champion's MIN RNG instead of Range 1-5.
Fixed an issue where the ability Heart Strike would affect relics.
Fixed an issue where the spell Lay Bridge was not converting affected Chasm spaces into Stone.

Fixed an issue where the ability Ooze Tap was affecting champions with alternate forms of flight like Arctic Flight.
Fixed an issue with the spell Mimic that was causing it to not appropriately copy the adjacent enemy champion's upgrade abilities.

notes.title: Expansion 28 Preview 3 and VoA Final Days Event!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

We are happy to reveal it's official name for Pox Nora's 28th Expansion, Spirits Beyond. As we get closer to the release of Spirits Beyond more will be revealed about what this the name of the expansion is eluding to in regards to lore. This will give all of you some time to speculate as to what that may be.

With today's preview we have more More great things for all of you including an all new event! But , before we get into any of that we need to address the previous contest and event.

Shard Reward Event
The Shard Reward event has come to an end. All shard rewards have been deposited into the accounts of all qualifying players. For details about the amount of shards see the Official Announcement.

Flavor Text Contest 2
The Spirits Beyond Flavor Text contest 2 has concluded. Congratulations to EmperorSauron and Goyo for submitting the flavor text we liked the most for Goblin King and Boundless Enthusiasm. The Shard prize has been deposited into their accounts.

Goblin King
Champion
Faction: Underdepths
Flavor Text: "Bring me his head! And his leg! And his eyes! I'm in a bad mood today." - Tolgra, Goblin King
By: EmperorSauron

Boundless Enthusiasm
Spell
Faction: Underdepths
Flavor Text: "I will punch him! Then I will punch him again! And I will kick him in the floor!" Goblin children playing
By: Goyo

Congratulations again to both EmperorSauron and Goyo!

Visions of Amareth Final Days Event
The Visions of Amareth expansion is coming to a close and to give it one final send-off we are giving all of you a chance to earn Expansion 27 packs! Starting right now, March 11th, and lasting until 5PM PST March 29th you can earn 1 Visions of Amareth pack for every 10 Ranked matches played. Matches must last a minimum of 10 minutes to count towards this event. For this event you can earn a maximum of 5 packs, but that isn't all!

Grand Prize
At the end of this event we will have a drawing from all the players who received all 5 packs, and one lucky player will get 1 of every Visions of Amareth rune including the Legendary runes in addition to the 5 packs!

You have 20 days to play 50 matches lasting over 10 minutes before the event ends March 29th 5PM PST (8PM EST, March 30th 12AM UTC) Rewards will be given out at the conclusion of this event. To redeem the packs once they have bee rewarded you will need to go to the Marketplace and click on the link that says Entitlements at the top of the screen.

Preview
Some of you mentioned about too much information spoiling the surprise of new runes. This week we are going old school. Gaze upon this illustration and ponder what these runes will be. They may not actually be what you think they are, and not belong to the faction you would normally assume.

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/Expansion28Preview 3.jpg

Shard & Token Sale
The Shard and Token pack sale is still going on and will last until Spirits Beyond is released (release date unannounced). Full details about the Shard Pack, Deluxe Shard Pack, or the Crazy Token Pack are on the Pox Nora Marketplace.

Weekend Tournament
This weekend's tournament is now available. It is a standard 4 person tournament, using Ranked Maps, with a total turn time limit per player per match of 30 minutes. This tournament will be available from March 11th through March 13th.

Rewards:

1st place: Myx Coordinator and 1 Gold Champion Point Token.
2nd place: Salaman Hunter and 1 Silver Champion Point Token.

Discussion: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-expansion-28-preview-3-and-voa-final-days-event.22101/

notes.title: Expansion 28 Preview 2, Contest, Packs, and More!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

Wow, it's already been a week.  That means it's Expansion 28 is all that much closer, but it also means new Rune Art!  Also, checkout details about the NEW PACK available on the Pox Nora marketplace for a limited time, this weekend's tournament, and more.

But First, we have the winners of last week's Flavor Text Contest to announce.  Congratulations to @badgerale and Goyo for submitting the flavor text we liked the most for Eroding Winds and Wounded Kitten.  The gold prize has been deposited into their accounts.

Eroding Winds
Spell
Faction: Ironfist Stronghold
Flavor Text: "I left the desert to escape sand storms. I didn't expect them in the mountains." Skeezick Merchan's Diary entry nº 309
By: Goyo

Wounded Kitten
Equipment
Faction: Shattered Peaks
Flavor Text:  "poor little thing, he broke his leg... but don't you worry, I'll tend you, and feed you, and we'll be best friends forever..." Dorn Stormbrunt (Deceased)
By: badgerale

Congratulations!

Preview
Now for the Rune Art preview.  He's big, he's green, and you don't want to make him mad because he just might take all your stuff with the help of his enthusiastic minions.

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/EXP28Goblin-ThronePreview.jpg

Some of you will be happy to know we are doing the flavor text contest again for this preview.

Flavor Text Contest
For the second Expansion 28 Flavor Text contest, players who want to participate can submit as many Flavor Texts for the two runes as they want. Flavor Text submitted to this contest can not exceed 250 characters (including spaces) and can not conflict with any current Pox Nora Lore. We are providing the names of the runes featured in the illustration, a description of the illustration, and info about what the runes do.

Players have until March 9th 10AM PST (1PM EST, 6 PM UTC) to post their flavor text in the submission thread at which point the thread will be locked. Make sure to state which rune the flavor text submission is for in your post. One submission for each rune featured will be chosen by us as the winner and the results will be announced March 11th.

Flavor Text Contest Submission Thread: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/expansion-28-flavor-text-contest-2.22014/

Rewards
The player or players who submit the two winning Flavor Texts will be awarded 200 Shards.

Illustration Description
A fat goblin with a tiny crown on his head. He sits on a throne covered with a lot of other crowns. He is pointing a scepter in a demanding gesture. Beside his throne is a smallish goblin leaping into an on-going brawl of ruffian goblins (the others don't need to be recognizable).

Goblin King
Type: Champion
Faction: Underdepths
Race: Goblin
Class: Demi-God, Wizard

Starting Abilities: Attack: Magica, Regeneration (Rank 3), Sovereign Bounty (NEW)
Upgrade Set 1: Pawn, Drain 2, Dictate
Upgrade Set 2: Encourage, Goblin Thievery, Boost

Sovereign Bounty
Description: This champion permanently gains a random non-basic attack ability from the next 3 champions you deploy from the runedock.

Boundless Enthusiasm
Spell
Faction: Underdepths
Description: Target champion gains Homing Sense and Pounce 3 for 6 turns.

Disclaimer: All Pox Nora content including but not limited to Characters, Story Plots, Places, Factions, and Mechanics are the property of Desert Owl Games. The winning Flavor Text or Texts may be edited by Desert Owl Games for consistency with Pox Nora cannon and contestants forfeit their rights of ownership to the submitted text. Goblin King, Boundless Enthusiasm, and Sovereign Bounty are still subject to change.

Shard & Token Sale
Starting now and lasting until the release of Expansion 28 (release date unannounced) 3 all new packs will be available on the Pox Nora Marketplace.  Grab the Shard Pack, Deluxe Shard Pack, or the Crazy Token Pack before the next expansion!

Shard Pack

Contents: 800 Shards for 500 Credits

Deluxe Shard Pack

Contents: 4000 Shards for 2000 Credits

Crazy Token Pack

Contents: 50 Platnium Tokens for 500 Credits

Shard Reward Event
It's the last weekend for the Shard Reward event.  Players have until 4PM PST March 9th to get in their combination of 50 total Ranked matches played or Single Player match wins to earn the 1000 shard max reward. Rewards will be given out at the conclusion of this event. For full details see the Official Announcement.

Weekend Tournament
This weekend's tournament is now available. It is a standard 4 person tournament, using Ranked Maps, with a total turn time limit per player per match of 30 minutes. This tournament will be available from March 4th through March 6th.

Rewards:

1st place: Rage of the Circle and 1 Gold Champion Point Token
2nd place: Snaptooth Hunter and 1 Silver Champion Point Token

Discussion: http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-expansion-28-preview-2-contest-packs-and-more.22015/

See you on the Battlefield!

Deluxe Shard Pack

Contents: 4000 Shards for 2000 Credits

Crazy Token Pack

Contents: 50 Platnium Tokens for 500 Credits

notes.title: Pox Nora Patch: January 28th, 2016
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

A new patch is now available, which includes bug fixes and design changes. 

Announcement

See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Visions of Amareth Midterm is here!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

The Visions of Amareth Midterm is here, and with it comes eight new Legendary runes, one Limited Edition rune, a new story, and more!

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/VoAMid1.jpg

Visions of Amareth Midterm Short Story Contest Results
In December we launched a contest giving players a chance for their short story to become part of Pox Nora Lore. The community narrowed down the entries to 3 finalists. All the entries were exceptional, resulting in this being extremely close decision, but after much deliberation Bellagion's entry A Field Report was determined to be the winner. The three finalists will be contacted regarding their prizes. Congratulations to Bellagion, the two other finalists Skullferno and badgerale, and a big thanks to everyone who participated.

General

The Visions of Amareth Midterm Pack has been added to the  Pox Nora Marketplace.  This pack will give 1 of the 8 new Legendary Visions of Amareth Midterm runes along with 2 Platinum Tokens.
The Outcast De'lim Skin Bundle has been added to the marketplace will award the Limited Edition Outcast De'lim rune with unique art and sprite, 1 of the 8 new Legendary midterm runes, and 2 Platinum Tokens.
A new story A Field Report by Bellagion is now available.

New Runes
Legendary

Croma Extinguisher
Cyclops Rockshaper
De'lim
Dunes Enigma
Flamebreath Ballista
Lonx Icelord
Salaman Privateer
Slitherine

Limited Edition

Outcast De'lim

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that was causing the equipment Ethereal Hammer not to function.
Fixed an issue that allowed for inactive runes to be crafted using the Rune Forge.
Fixed an issue where the relic Ethereal Pool was inappropriately giving illusions Scornful.
Fixed an issue that was causing Heroic Achievements to not properly reset or track progress for some players.
Fixed an issue that allowed champions with the ability Brushwalker to move over impassable terrain if those tile spaces were Vegetation.
Fixed an issue with the ability Nora Pearls that allowed its effects to stack.
Fixed an issue preventing the spell Nora Drain from being cast.
Fixed an issue preventing the Scythe Whirl ability's buff from being dispelled.
Fixed an issue with the ability Fire Blast that was causing it to hit friendly champions.
Fixed an issue where the ability Equip: Heretic Shackle could equip unequipable champions.
Fixed an issue where the ability Magnate's Blessing would not trigger Quest: Support Ally.
Fixed an issue where the condition form the spell Taint could not be dispelled.
Fixed an issue where a champion with the ability Precision could still miss if the target was under the effects of the spell Whispers of the Mind.
Fixed an issue where some players Avatars would have abilities that were above rank 3. All abilities on Avatars should not go higher than rank 3.

Changes
For a full list of all the changes checkout the Official Patch Notes. 

Abilities & Conditions 
Forglar Swamp 
Forsaken Wastes
Ironfist Stronghold 
K'thir Forest 
Savage Tundra 
Shattered Peaks 
Sundered Lands 
Underdepths 

See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: December Patch Released with Winter Holiday Packs and Campaign!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

This is the last patch of the year and we have many joyous things.

We have given one Legendary champions form each faction a holiday makeover. These festive combatants will be available in the Holiday Reskins pack. For those who want to spend some gold there is also a Holiday Extended Set Special pack that guarantees a Legendary and Exotic runes.

For those who love a good Single Player challenge a Winter Holiday campaign is also available for free for a limited time. Romp around as the abominable rhyming Krampus as it revels in the displeasure of others in joyous glee.

The Holiday Packs and Campaign will only be available until January 4th, 2016.

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/holiday_GaruSmall.jpg

General

Added a new festive Holiday Reskins pack to the Pox Nora Marketplace. Each pack comes with 1 Limited Edition rune from 8 holiday themed reskins of legendary runes and 2 platinum tokens.
Added a new Holiday Extended Set Special pack to the Marketplace. Each of these packs give the following runes from the Extended Set: 1 legendary, 1 exotic, 2 rares, 4 uncommons and 4 commons.
For a limited time an all new Winter Holiday campaign will be available to all players. Completing this campaign on Legendary difficulty will award 2 Platinum tokens.
Removed the gold notification for progressing to a new League to address confusion regarding gold earned.
Avatar abilities are now capped at Rank 3


Website

Only players who have reached the Battlemaster league will now appear on the Ranking's page.
Updated the rankings and player profile pages to properly use the new League icons.
Added new wallpapers to the website Pox Nora Website.


Design Change

Temporary Incorporeal conditions can now be removed by Dispel effects


Bugs

Fixed several issues that caused errors in matches.
Fixed an issue where the ability Nexus Aura was not functioning properly.
Fixed an issue where Tournaments would crash resulting in any active tournaments ending prematurely.
The conditions from the abilities abilities Mirefolk Fealty, Mirefolk Resurgence, and Mirefolk Transcendence can now be properly removable via Dispel.
The effects from the spell Vampirism can now be properly removed via Dispel.
Fixed an issue with the launcher where clicking Account would not take the player to the appropriate webpage.
Fixed an issue where Zombie Apocalypse would not properly consider summoned Festering Corpse's for giving the ability Swarm: Festering Corpse.
Fixed an issue where the ability Black Tempest would continue to hit enemy champions that are outside of it's area of effect.
Fixed issues with the spells Call of the Tundra and Drone Signal where the summoned champions would still drop Nora Globes.
Fixed the following issues with the ability Tidal Wave:

Fixed an issue where it was not properly affecting friendly units
Fixed an issue where the targeting template would remain present after activation
Fixed the broken Combat log message

Fixed an issue where the ability Holy Armaments was incorrectly triggering when an enemy champion was equipped.
Fixed and issue where the ability Healing Wind would continue to heal a friendly champion that moved out of range.
Fixed an issue with Haunting Visions where it was giving the wrong buffs and had an incorrect tooltip
Fixed an issue where champions could still become Inhibited from the Diseased condition even if they had the ability Immunity: Disease.
Fixed an issue where the Large champions would not be affected by the ability Dreamstate.
Fixed an issue where the condition possessed from the ability Sleeper Agent could be inappropriately cleansed or removed.
Fixed an issue where the Sandblasted from the spell Sandstorm would only lasts 3 turns instead of 6.
Fixed an issue where the ability New Growth would create a real champion not a summoned champion.
Fixed an issue where the abilities Electric Overload and Frost Overload would equip Unequippable units.
Fixed an issue where the spell Obelus would do damage even on abilities that return invalid target.
Fixed an issue where the spell Consecrate the Earth was missing its rune art in-game.
Fixed an issue where the spell Spell Ward was missing its rune art in-game.
Fixed an issue where players weren't getting the proper Battlemaster icons.


For a full list of all the Faction and Ability changes checkout the Official Patch Notes.

Join the Discussion on the Forums.

See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Visions of Amareth Expansion Released
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

Pox Nora's 27th expansion, Visions of Amareth, is now available!

https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/EXP27Launche.jpg


General

50 New runes have been added to Pox Nora.
8 Limited Edition versions of revised runes have been added to Pox Nora.
Visions of Amareth Pack has been added to the Marketplace. This pack comes with: 6 common, 3 uncommon, and 1 rare rune. Each rare slot has a 10% chance of becoming an exotic. Also this pack comes with 1 Platinum champion point token.
Visions of Amareth Box has been added to the Marketplace. This box comes with 10 Visions of Amareth packs. Get 9 packs and the 10th is FREE. The first pack is guaranteed to contain an exotic and two Limited Edition champions. Additionally, this box comes with 500 FREE shards.
Path of De'lim Megabox has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This Mega Box comes with three Visions of Amareth boxes, one Limited Edition relic, and 5 extra platinum tokens.
A new League system has been added to Pox Nora along with League rewards. Players will now be able to earn rewards including runes from the Visions of Amareth expansion by playing Ranked PvP matches. Rewards will be earned for each new league the player reaches. Ranked 1v1 and 2v2 leagues will have separate progressions and both will have their own rewards. This new ranking system will reset upon every expansion cycle.
Path of De’lim expansion is now available on the rune forge has been added to Extended Packs and Boxes.
The next installment of the ever enduring Pox Nora story is now available.
Updated 300+ abilities, spells, relics, and equipment to use popup condition tooltips for descriptions.

League Rewards

Standard League V (Level 1) - Starting Level
Standard League IV (Level 2) - 1000 Gold
Standard League III (Level 3) - 3x Commons from Visions of Amareth
Standard League II (Level 4) - 3000 Gold
Standard League I (Level 5) - 3x Uncommon from Visions of Amareth
Rare League (Level 6) - 500 Shards
Exotic League (Level 7) - 2x Rare from Visions of Amareth
Legendary League (Level 8) - 1000 Shards
Limited League (Level 9) - 1x Exotic from Visions of Amareth
Battlemaster League (Level 10) - Ice Dragon Statue LE and Flaming Skull LE

Next League Requirements
+1 Points for a Ranked Loss, +2 Points for a Ranked Win

Standard League V (Level 1) - 5 points
Standard League IV (Level 2) - 10 points
Standard League III (Level 3) - 15 points
Standard League II (Level 4) - 20 points

0 Points for a Ranked Loss, +2 Points for a Ranked Win

Standard League I (Level 5) - 25 points
Rare League (Level 6) - 30 Points

-1 Points for a Ranked Loss, +2 Points for a Ranked Win

Exotic League (Level 7) - 35 Points
Legendary League (Level 8) - 40 Points

-2 Points for a Ranked Loss, +2 Points for a Ranked Win

Limited League (Level 9) - 50 Points
Battlemaster League (Level 10) - Top League

Bug Fixes

Fixed an exploit that would allow players to trade untradeable runes.
Fixed a display bug regarding the expanded deployment zone from the ability Necrosis that would occur after reconnecting to the game if disconnected or in observer mode.
Fixed an issue with the spell Razor Ice that was preventing it's area of effect from being shown.
Fixed an interaction issue with the spell Loot and the equipment Chillshard where the equipment would still continue to chill your units instead of the opponent's.
Fixed an issue when the ability Psychological Warfare applies Confused to a Frightened target. If the target was already Confused the ability would cause upgrades to return to the champion.
Fixed an issue with the map Tundra Lake that was preventing terrain changes on some tiles.
Fixed an issue with the map Underdepths where some tiles were not properly indicating they were Lava.
Fixed an issue with the map Ironfist Mountains where some tiles were not properly accessible.
Fixed an issue where champions with the Elite ability could be destroyed by the equipment Forbidden Fruit.
Fixed an issue where the effects of not being able to gain AP would remain on a champion after the ability Blood Fueled was removed.
Fixed issue with the ability Mason's Spire rank 1 not properly having AE5.
Fixed an issue with the spell Minefield where the mines would continue to be visible to the opponent after being destroyed.
Added the ability to forge and sacrifice Legendary Equipment, Relics, and Spells in the Rune Forge.
Fixed an issue with the spell False Orders where this spell's global effect would be removed if the same player deployed a champion.
Fixed an issue with the spell False Orders where the global effect was not properly displaying its description.
Removed the requirement of a Deployment Zone for the spell False Orders.
Fixed an issue where champions with the Compelled condition could still attack relics.
Champions with the ability Boss can no longer get the condition Plagued this was done to resolve an issue where the on death effect would not trigger.
Fixed an issue with the abilities Psychic Agony and Defensive Turtle where they were not triggering if the cause of the HP reduction was Loss of Life.
Fixed an issue where the equipment Bone Circle Staff would sometimes be duplicated when the on death effect would trigger. Also, fixed an issue where some champions couldn't equip the staff.

Drums of War and Player Ranks
All players who played a minimum of 50 ranked matches and their primary faction was the Drums of War Winning Faction, Underdepths, have been awarded 2000 Gold along with 5 Three Day Gold Bonus Tokens.

For a full list of all the changes in the Visions of Amareth go to the Official Patch Noteson the Pox Nora forums.

See you on the Battlefield!

Path of De’lim Midterm Bundle

Lodestone Megalith

Eretat Guardian
Minotaur Thunderaxe
Whirling Quarry
Genesis Lich

New Limited Edition Runes

Thunderaxe (Equipment)


Website

Eretat Guardian
Treasure Hunter
Seventh Genesis
Salaman Appraiser



Conditions

Branded: When a Paladin, Priest, or Shaman makes a basic attack against this champion, the target takes 2 additional fire damage (ignores Def). This does not stack.

Fixed an issue where the ability Brain Eater was causing matches to crash.

Fixed an issue where the ability Worm Lord was incorrectly triggering on summons.
Fixed an issue where the ability Blood Convergence was incorrectly dealing less damage if the Blood Balls were stacked on the same space.
Fixed an issue where the spell Sandstorm did not have the proper area of effect range for it's damage.

Happy Playing!

notes.title: Path of De’lim is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

Pox Nora’s 26th expansion, Path of De’lim, is now available! Path of De’lim introduces many new runes, abilities, Heroic Achievements, story content, and much more.

Drums of War Rewards
To add a more competitive element to Drums of War all players who played a minimum of 50 ranked matches and their primary faction was the Winning Faction, Underdepths, have been awarded 2000 Gold along with 5 Three Day Gold Bonus Tokens.

General

42 New runes have been added to Pox Nora.
16 Limited Edition versions of revised runes have been added to Pox Nora.
Path of De'lim Pack has been added to the Marketplace. This pack comes with: 5 common, 3 uncommon, and 1 rare rune. Each rare slot has a 10% chance of becoming an exotic. One guaranteed Limited Edition from the expansion along with 1 champion point token.
Path of De'lim Box has been added to the Marketplace. This box comes with 10 Path of De'lim packs for the price of 9 packs. The first pack is guaranteed to contain an exotic. Additionally, this box comes with 300 FREE shards.
Path of De'lim Megabox has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This Megabox comes with three Path of De'lim boxes and a whopping 1500 FREE shards.
Lobby chat has been replaced by a new Global lobby. This is a persistent chat that is available both in-match and all lobbies. Private messages will show up in this chat, so you will never have to miss out on what is happening in chat.
Heroic Achievements have been added to the game. These are longer term achievements that will last 2 weeks, and are intended to encourage players to make design changes to their decks to receive sizable rewards. Each heroic achievement will be comprised of 4 long term achievements each one is worth between 1500 and 3000 gold and upon completing all 4, the player will receive 500 shards. There will be over 20 Heroic Achievement sets for this expansion.
Shard Packs have been removed from the Marketplace
The next part of the Pox Nora story is now available


Map Rotation
The ranked map rotation has been changed to include the following maps.

Dark Marsh
Forglar Swamp
Forsaken Wastes
Grove of Ashes
Ironfist Mountains
Ironfist Pass
K'thir Hill
Nora Glades
Ruins of Valdac
Shores of Maljara
Snarling Tangle
Underdepths


Ranking
The ranking system rating win/loss caps have been updated.
OLD:

Minimum amount of rating gained for a win = 1
Maximum amount of rating lost for a loss = 32

NEW:

Minimum amount of rating gained for a win = 5
Maximum amount of rating lost for a loss = 20


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that was prevent all of the abilities on Avatars from appearing. Note: There is a known issue with how all of the abilities are displayed for the Avatars on the Rune Manager.
Fixed an issue with the campaign Maljaran Frontier Pt.2, where the dialog would not properly trigger on Mission 5.
We have increased the amount of nora generated in the second mission of the campaign: The Land of Mutants. This should make the mission a little easier.
Fixed an issue with the Spell: Murkwater Weakness where it was incorrectly affecting Shrines and Relics.
The ability Storm Field has been removed from the attack chain.
Fixed an issue where Bone Prison was not following the standard targeting rules, allowing the ability to be cast on Avatars or through abilities such as Impenetrable.
Fixed an issue that allowed Carouse to be usable on an unequippable champions, also fixed an issue where this was not usable on enemy champions.
Fixed an issue where the Ability: Dimension Shift did not have an Icon.
Fixed an issue where Leagues only allocated 1000 spaces, so anybody outside the top 1000 shows up as 5000 out of -1001, in no league.
The equipment Crown of Petals is now uncleansable.
Fixed an issue where the Savage Tundra font bonus tooltip description was incorrect.
Updated the spawn locations of the Draksar Hunters for the mission “An Unlikely Alliance” in the “Skeezick Rebellion” campaign to resolve a progression issue.
Updated the spawn locations of the Flood Generator for the mission “Hoppin' Mad 1” in the “Hoppin' Mad” campaign to resolve a progression issue. Also, added the Flood Generator to the mission’s objectives.
Fixed an issue with the ability Zombie Plague that was causing the deployed champion to gain Plaguebearer for 6 turns. Therefore, after it has been out for 6 turns, it will no longer be able to spread the Plague.
Fixed an issue that was preventing players from completing the mission “Utterdark Approaches” in the “The Angels Descend” campaign.
Fixed an issue with the ability Bear Form that was preventing if from being dispelled.
Fixed an issue with the ability Adaptation that was preventing it from being dispelled.
Fixed an issue that was causing Domain: Dead Magic Zone to not trigger properly when Dead Magic Zone is generated on a unit.
Fixed an issue with the ability Thrash that was causing it to not have a rang preview.
Fixed an issue that was causing the Immortal Ward to not always spawn during the mission “Praise Sarinda!” in the “Hunt for Sarinda” campaign. Also, fixed a minor typo on the end of match screen for this mission.
Fixed an issue where Skirmish Bots would sometimes use decks with runes from more than 2 factions.
Fixed an issue where the ability Designate Flagbearer was incorrectly giving improve speed to everyone in the AE, instead of just giving it to the champion.
Fixed an issue where the spell Desecration was dealing "loss of life" Magic damage, and bypasses Spell Resistance and Resistances.
Fixed an issue where the ability Sentinel did not trigger Preparation.
Fixed an issue where the ability Chains of Amareth was incorrectly stacking, and was not triggering Backlash. Also, fixed an issue where it was causing the champion with this ability to not lose HP if it had been damaged.


For a full list of all the changes to the Factions go to the Official Patch Notes on the Pox Nora forums.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Coalitions Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,
 
The 25th Pox Nora expansion, Coalitions, is now here!  Coalitions introduces many new runes, abilities, and a challenging single player campaign with an exciting new reward, and much more.

Launch Gift
To celebrate the launch of Coalitions, we have given everyone 500 free Shards.

Launch Event
Earn an additional 250 shards for every 10 ranked games you play during this period. Rewards handed out at the end of the Event period.  Matches must last over 10 minutes to qualify. 

General

New Runes: 64 new runes have been added with the release of the Coalitions expansion
New Map Rotation: A new map rotation is in for the Coalitions expansion, 6 of which have received updates
New Packs: A new Coalitions Pack has been added to the Marketplace
New Boxes: A new Coalitions Box which includes 300 Rune Forge Shards has been added to the Marketplace
New Mega Box: a new limited time Coalitions Mega Box has been added to the Marketplace. The Mega Box gives 3 Coalitions Boxes and 1500 Rune Forge Shards!
Tournaments: Basic free tournaments have been enabled.
Rune Forge Shard Ratios Improvement: Rune Forge rates have been updated to be more player friendly, with improved shard values when sacrificing runes. Our goals were:
Increased shard generation for all rarities (between 125% to 250% relative to previous values)
IN/OUT ratios are now consistent between Core and Extended Set
Decreased number of runes required to move up tiers
It will now take 20 Rares to craft a Legendary, compared to the previous 30
It will now take 4 Exotics to craft a Legendary, compared to the previous 7.5
 Increased yield when moving down tiers
Sharding a Rare will now allow you to craft 5 Uncommons, compared to the 0.83 previously
Sharding an Exotic will now allow you to craft 2.5 Rares, compared to the 0.8 previously
Extended Set Runes values are now fixed at 200% of Core Set costs
Player Rewards: All single player tutorials, campaigns, and daily skirmish matches will now award players core set runes upon successful completion.
Ronin Runes added to Extended Set packs and boxes.
An all new challenging single player campaign is now available on the Marketplace. This campaign follows the PoxNora story where it left off, and while Menalaus is absent from the forest a Group called the Nefari Resurrection have come together to try and gain control of K'thir Forest. Also for the first time ever players who beat this campaign on Legendary difficulty will earn a FREE Limited Edition rune!
Daily Skirmish: Added a new Daily Skirmish called "Old Things"
All the runes with a * at the end of their name have been removed. Every player that had these runes will have them replaced with the normal version with the same upgrades selected and at the same level.
Champion Costing Update:
The costing formula for runes has been adjusted slightly. Cost for DEF, particularly for higher HP units, has been reduced, while costs for base HP has been increased. For the majority of champions, this results in little to no change. Units whose costs are largely in HP will see their cost go up, while units that were previously paying significant nora for DEF may see some cost decrease. Overall, costs will have increased by an average of around 2 nora, with the brunt of the increases being borne by the champions on the lower end of the cost spectrum, which should go some ways towards correctly some of the efficiency issues with those champions.


Maps
The ranked Map Rotation has been updated. There are now 12 maps in the ranked rotation with several of them with updated shrine and nora font locations.

Axillium
Elemental Plateau
Lava Plains
Lost City
Forsaken Wastes
Shores of Maljara
Brood Pits (Updated)
Ironfist Pass (Updated)
K'thir Forest (Updated)
Ruins of Valdac (Updated)
Sundered Lands (Updated)
Tundra Lake (Updated)


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue with the game client where decks were displaying in reverse alphabetical order
Fixed an issue with the SP Faction Bonus, Ancient Implications and Mark of Redemption not triggering upon champion death in some cases
Fixed an issue where Prestige caused improper stacking of Iron Will and Fearless
Fixed an issue where Surge abilities were improperly counting Illusions when applying the stat modifier.
Fixed an issue where Sermon was not removing the +5 HP from champions that had been damaged.
Fixed an issue where Wolf Pack was only giving the primary wolf all of the damage bonuses that should have been applied evenly to the other wolves summoned from the Timber Wolves rune.
Fixed an issue where the Maximum HP from intoxicated was not being removed when Intoxicated wore off.
Fixed an issue with Swarm and its variants, where they were using an incorrect form of basic attack detection. This was causing them to only detect the most recent basic attack gained.
Fixed an issue where Reflesh's effects were not removable
Form Change abilities have been redone to fix various issues


Drums of War and Player Ranks
Drums of War and Player Ranks have been reset. The Players who were the highest contributors to their faction and highest ranked player from each faction have been awarded 15000 Gold.
 
For a full list of all the changes and go to the Official Patch Notes on the Pox Nora Forums
 
http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/coalitions-patch-notes.15260/
 
Enjoy!

notes.title: PoxNora Wild Alliance Legends Update Released
notes.content:
About the Game
PoxNora is a collectible, turn-based, tactical, online fantasy game. Players command armies of fantastic creatures, cast spells of devastating power, and summon relics and equipment of ancient renown in order to defeat their opponents.

Key Features:
•	Delve into classic turn-based strategy gaming with elements of table top miniatures, chess and TCG style gameplay all wrapped into one 
•	Choose a side of good, evil, or a little of both through full or split faction play 
•	Build your collection of runes over time and customize your decks through the rune manager
•	Trade any or all of your runes with the entire community
•	Battle and wage war against opponents through exciting player vs. player gameplay
•	Join in draft tournaments to win prizes 
•	Earn experience for your champions through single player or pvp gameplay
•	Save up and spend gold that you earn after every match to get your hands on runes through the Player Rewards store
•	Free – to – play; optional content (including Wild Alliance Legends release) available for purchase

Wild Alliance Legends:
PoxNora’s Wild Alliance Legends, released in January 2012, will once again unleash the power of wizards and warlocks upon the world of Poxanthuru.  Fight for good (protectorate) or evil (wrath) and unleash the power of these unique characters on your opponent in tournaments, single player and pvp play.  Here’s a taste of some of the new abilities available in this purchase:  
•	Cast: Antimagic Field - For 6 turns, all spell damage is prevented.*  
•	Swarm: Arctic Beast - When this champion destroys a champion on a basic attack, a Level 1 Arctic Beast champion is spawned under your control in the location the destroyed champion occupied.*
*Abilities are subject to change

System Requirements 
•	Windows ME/2000/XP/Vista
•	500 MHz
•	512mb of RAM
•	Java 1.5 or Higher click to download
•	Nvidia or ATi Video Card with 64mb (minimum), 128mb (preferred) VRAM with current video drivers.
•	220MB of Hard drive space
•	56k Modem or better
